question: Which named initiation must be conferred according to the prescribed ritual procedure?
premises: An initiation named svastika-ārohaṇa is specified.
The initiation is the object to be given.
The giving must follow prescribed procedure.
inference: The officiant should confer the initiation called svastika-ārohaṇa according to prescription.
plain_english: He should give the initiation known as svastika-ārohaṇa according to the prescribed method.
